dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, serrated outer perimeters with high-contrast transitions from dark charcoal backgrounds to light grey/white borders. The most prominent mid-dorsal annulus features a jagged light-colored ring with a clearly defined darker interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, high-intensity pixel clusters localized along the ventral-lateral boundary. Core concentrations of maximum-intensity pixels are observed forming vertical, parallel striations near the neck region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. The distance between the primary mid-dorsal 'O' structure and the adjacent posterior 'C' structure is roughly double the diameter of the 'O' structure's centroid.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive series of three vertically aligned, high-intensity light bands located on the lateral neck area, exhibiting a 'claw-mark' like geometry contrasting with the surrounding spotted texture.
